How RPM is estimated

Motor RPM = KV × cell count × volts per cell × efficiency. Estimated head RPM = motor RPM × throttle percentage ÷ overall drive ratio. This is a simplified linear throttle estimate, not governed head speed under load. Some SAB models use an effective two-stage gear equivalent rather than physical main gear teeth. Model presets are limited to previously source-checked entries; confirm your installed drivetrain and revision.
